server_notes:
HOST/PORT: binds 127.0.0.1 only (local-only, private data never leaves machine). Default port 7799, overridable via `--port <n>` CLI arg. Server class: http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer (thread-per-request) with custom Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler). HERE = grid.HERE is the serve/asset root. log_message is overridden to no-op (silent console).

RESPONSES: every handler ends by sending HTTP 200 with Content-Length; there are no non-200 status codes — error conditions (missing file, unknown endpoint, exceptions) are returned as 200 with an error string/JSON body. do_GET builds body+ctype then writes; do_POST reads Content-Length bytes, json.loads the body (empty/garbage -> {}), dispatches /talk or /do.

STATIC-FILE RULES: _static_path() enforces (1) flat basename only — os.path.basename(path.split('?')[0].lstrip('/')) strips any directory/traversal component, so ../ escapes and subpaths cannot reach parent or private dirs; (2) extension allowlist via _CTYPES = {.js:application/javascript, .css:text/css, .png:image/png, .svg:image/svg+xml, .woff2:font/woff2, .map:application/json, .ico:image/x-icon, .wav:audio/wav, .mp3:audio/mpeg}; anything else returns None and falls through to the dashboard catch-all. This deliberately BLOCKS the private state stores (.json like luis_memory/grid_state/aea_state, plus *.md and *.py) from ever being reachable over the socket. File must exist (os.path.isfile) or None. The static check runs AFTER all the named HTML routes and BEFORE /workspace and the dashboard else-branch. Note the named HTML routes (/brain /city /plan /builder /mind /tree /poster /room /workspace /decisions /events) use startswith matching, while /state /journal /skills /roster /autonomy /chains use exact ==.

TELEGRAM BRIDGE: started in main() only if grid.key('TELEGRAM_TOKEN') is set — imports telegram_bridge and runs telegram_bridge.run() on a daemon thread (two-way phone conversation channel). Import/run failure is caught and printed, non-fatal.

STARTUP: main() parses --port; unless --no-open is passed, a threading.Timer(0.6s) opens the browser to http://127.0.0.1:<port>; then srv.serve_forever() (KeyboardInterrupt = clean shutdown, 'entity keeps living').

/do COMMAND ENDPOINT (allowlisted 'motor cortex', req JSON {cmd}): 
- brief -> subprocess.run [python, brief.py] cwd=HERE timeout=300, returns last 10 lines.
- consolidate -> subprocess.run [python, consolidate.py --limit 2] timeout=600, last 6 lines.
- status -> calls state(), returns a one-line summary (alive-since/wakes/ticks/memories/sessions/brief).
- play -> checks LIVE_PID_FP (live_pid.json) + Windows `tasklist` for an existing live.py pid; if none, subprocess.Popen [python, live.py] DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP with stdout/stderr appended to live.log, then grid.atomic_save_json records {pid,started}. Survives the request but not reboot.
- stop -> reads pid from live_pid.json, Windows `taskkill /PID <pid> /F`, clears the pid file. 'stopping is sleep not death'.
- tick -> subprocess.run [python, live.py --interval 1 --ticks 1] timeout=420 (blocking, ~1 min), last 8 lines.
- unknown cmd -> {ok:false, out:'unknown command ... (allowed: brief, consolidate, status, play, stop, tick)'}.

/talk COMMAND ENDPOINT (req JSON {text, zone, speak}): serialized by module-level _talk_lock (one exchange at a time). zone='local' maps to internal 'sensitive' (forces local-only rod), anything else -> 'private'. Flow: pulse.emit hears-luis -> talk_mod.load_state -> load identity.json + read talk_mod.SEED_PATH -> append luis turn -> talk_mod.answer(text,st,ident,seed,zone) -> append entity turn (capped to last 60) -> talk_mod.save_state. If req.speak and trust.check('speak').allowed, spawns speak_mod.speak on a daemon thread (cloud_ok = zone!=sensitive). Records the exchange as a type='chain' record to chains.jsonl (recall+draw links), and if the draw succeeded spawns watch_reply() on a daemon thread — the CONTINUOUS SURVEILLANCE watcher (Law 3) that draws a verdict rod (sensitive->local zone, else reflex), writes a type='verdict' record to chains.jsonl and pulse.emit's watcher/talk-verdict.

Module-level helpers/globals: chain_write() appends to chains.jsonl with 400KB rotation to chains.jsonl.1; tail() reads last-n lines; state()/journal()/skills()/roster() build the JSON payloads; PAGE = the embedded control-room HTML; ORGANS_DOC = static 17-organ registry list; LIVE_PID_FP = HERE/live_pid.json. Imports: grid, consolidate, trust, pulse, talk (as talk_mod), speak (as speak_mod), energy (as energy_mod), and optional autonomy (as autonomy_mod, None if import fails).
